research_matrix_strategies.scope: Actual transport matrices; paper-inspired algebra probes, no flame solve or production changes
limitations: ACA stores/scans full residual; timing is not an optimized PPACA implementation.
Neumann uses the existing native Schur matrix and diagonal scaling, not the full MuTLib algorithm or collision model.
Cantera validation belongs to the original complete property path; matrix residuals alone do not validate new physical outputs.
Fixed-state Jacobian checks for nine mechanisms are not nine converged flames.
Converged-flame regression covers the six existing H2/GRI cases only.
GPU proof is a captured thermal LU/RHS stage, repeated single matrices, not complete transport.
The serial CPU GPU comparison is not a GPU comparison against production parallel CPU.
Strict byte equality to the native baseline is separate from the stated Cantera tolerances.
The earlier 8-face profiling/tuning range was 600-2300 K; final comparisons use each common NASA interval.

gpu_parallel_cpu_comparison.scope: native parallel face LU/RHS vs ordered CUDA only; no flame speedup claim
